rationale: Both independently surface the same genuine unaddressed bug (double PCM sample-rate conversion in seed_tts_eval) and raise the dialect-removal concern comparably well, matching ground truth's amy-why-3459 thread. But on the audio_vae config-mutation concern (ground truth's other real thread), Y correctly scopes it as a metadata-only issue — exactly matching LHXuuu's authoritative explanation that the encoder's actual layer count is unaffected — while X confidently asserts with fabricated-sounding 'verification' that the encoder is truncated to 4 layers, directly contradicting the maintainer's resolution. Y also correctly validates the patch_emission +2 change against the HF reference (matching ground truth's conclusion it's intentional, not a bug), whereas X treats it as an unexplained magic number needing tests. X's confident wrong claims hurt its precision more than Y's denser but better-calibrated findings.
